localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description: This site is nestled in the trees in the far left hand corner of the group site area from the entrance.  This site is most suitable for tenting with space for a few camping units. It is quite private and shaded with trees. There are picnic tables and a communal fire pit in the site. The shower and washroom building nearby is available for all the group sites to use.

localizedValues.name: G2
localizedValues.description: This site is nestled in the trees in the far right hand corner of the group site area from the entrance.  This site is more suitable for tenting with space for a few camping units. It is quite private and shaded with trees. There are picnic tables and a communal fire pit in the site. The shower/toilet building nearby is available for all the group sites to use.

localizedValues.name: G3
localizedValues.description: This is a field site situated within the group site area to the left from the entrance and across from the shower/toilet building. There is plenty of room for campers and RV's and tents in this area. Picnic tables and a communal fire pit are supplied. This site is very roomy and will fit a large group. The vehicles, camping units and tents all arrange into the open field area whichever way is preferred, utilizing the picnic tables and fire pit area.

localizedValues.name: G4
localizedValues.description: This is a field site situated within the group site area immediately to the right from the entrance. There is plenty of room for campers and RV's and tents in this area. Picnic tables and a communal fire pit are supplied. This site is very roomy and will fit a large group. The vehicles, camping units and tents all arrange into the open field area whichever way is preferred, utilizing the picnic tables and fire pit area.

localizedValues.name: S1-Picnic Shelter
localizedValues.description:
This picnic shelter is situated in the day use area of the park in the field area. It is a private site nestled under the trees further from the beach and playground and protected from the ocean breezes. There is a shelter with picnic tables and running water. The shelter has seating for approximately 40; please bring extra chairs if needed. No BBQ at shelter, group has to bring their own. Very popular during the summer for weddings, family/friend/work gatherings as well as children's birthday parties!
Liquor can only be consumed on registered campsites by legal adults. Drinking alcohol is prohibited in all day-use and public frontcountry areas, including campground washrooms and roadways.

localizedValues.name: S2-Picnic Shelter
localizedValues.description:
This picnic shelter is situated in the day use field area of the park closer to the beach. There is a shelter with picnic tables and running water and a path next to the site leading to the playground. The shelter has seating for approximately 40; please bring extra chairs if needed. No BBQ at shelter, group has to bring their own. Very popular during the summer for weddings, family/friend/work gatherings as well as children's birthday parties!
Liquor can only be consumed on registered campsites by legal adults. Drinking alcohol is prohibited in all day-use and public frontcountry areas, including campground washrooms and roadways.
